source: Madness has confused the target, lowering mind resistance by %d%% and making it act randomly (%d%% chance)
target: 疯狂使目标混乱，降低目标 %d%% 精神抗性，使目标随机行动（%d%% 概率）。

source: Entombs a single target in a wall of stone.
target: 将一个单位用岩石墙环绕。

source: Displacing %d%% of all damage on to a random enemy.
target: 将 %d%% 伤害转移至随机敌人。

source: %s feeds you hate from its latest victim. (+%d hate)
target: %s 从它最近的受害者身上为你提供仇恨。（+%d 仇恨）
新的职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#心灵杀手（灵能系）

source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The air whirls at your side and suddenly High Sun Paladin Aeryn appears!*#WHITE#
Then you shall not fight alone! Together we shall stop them, or die trying!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*空气在你身边回旋，突然高阶太阳骑士艾琳出现了！*#WHITE#
你不必独自作战！我们要一起阻止他们，哪怕付出生命！

deep_observation: 译文遗漏三处源文语义：(1)「One of the ruby eyes」译作「一只眼睛」，丢掉 ruby；同一冻结版本 engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/locales/zh_hans.lua:38485 把该物品名 Atamathon 的 Ruby Eye 译为「阿塔玛森的红宝石眼睛」，描述与名称脱节。(2)「legendary giant golem」译作「传奇傀儡」，丢掉 giant；同文件 2692 行作「巨型傀儡阿塔玛森」、38469 行作「傀儡之王阿塔玛森」。(3)「deal a crippling blow」（予兽人重创）整个未译，只剩「使对方的首领…走向死亡」。源文见 game/modules/tome/data/zones/golem-graveyard/objects.lua:23-27（define_as=ATAMATHON_RUBY_EYE、subtype=red、image=atamathons_lost_ruby_eye.png，desc 在 26-27 行）。另记：本条把 Age of Pyre 由该版本 zh_hans.lua 中 42 处一致的「派尔纪」改为「烈火纪」（该版本内 0 处），因禁读项目术语表无法核验是否为既定迁移，按第七节标记证据不足，未据此判定。
source:
One of the ruby eyes of the legendary giant golem Atamathon.
It is said it was made by the halflings during the Age of Pyre as a weapon against the orcs. Even though it was destroyed, it managed to deal a crippling blow by killing their leader, Garkul the Devourer.
surface_observation: 首句漏译 ruby（红宝石）和 giant（巨型），且原文首句后的换行被删除。
target: 那只传奇傀儡——阿塔玛森的一只眼睛。据说它是半身人在烈火纪为了对抗兽人所造的武器。虽然它被破坏了，但是它也成功地使对方的首领吞噬者加库尔走向死亡。

deep_observation: (1) 结构丢失：冻结源文在「The power will increase with your Spellpower.」与「#AQUAMARINE#Ice storm:#LAST#」之间有一整行空行（engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/talents/spells/water.lua:200-205，第 203 行为空行，源串该处为连续两个换行加两个制表符），译文只保留一个换行，嵌入的 %s 冰雪风暴子描述与正文粘连。(2) 同处「效果受法术强度加成」缺句末句号，源文该句以句点收尾，同版本 zh_hans.lua:26697 的旧译亦作「效果受法术强度加成。」。(3)「You absorb latent cold around you」译作「你吸收周围的寒冰围绕你」，「围绕你」是 around you 的重复残留且无所依附，句子不成立；latent cold（潜藏的寒气）被窄化为「寒冰」，并增译源文没有的「纯粹的」。
source:
You absorb latent cold around you, turning into an ice elemental - a shivgoroth - for %d turns.
		While transformed, you do not need to breathe, gain access to the Ice Storm talent at level %d, gain %d%% resistance to cuts and stuns, gain %d%% cold resistance, and all cold damage heals you for %d%% of the damage done.
		The power will increase with your Spellpower.

		#AQUAMARINE#Ice storm:#LAST#
		%s
surface_observation: 原文法术强度加成说明与 Ice storm 标题之间为双换行，译文变为单换行，丢失段落空行。
target:
你吸收周围的寒冰围绕你，将自己转变为纯粹的冰元素——西弗格罗斯，持续 %d 回合。
		转化成元素后，你不需要呼吸并获得等级 %d 的冰雪风暴，获得 %d%% 震慑和流血抵抗，%d%% 寒冷伤害抗性。所有寒冷伤害可对你产生治疗，治疗量基于伤害值的 %d%%。
		效果受法术强度加成
		#AQUAMARINE#冰雪风暴：#LAST#
		%s

deep_observation: 末句「The detection abilities improve with Cunning.」为复数 abilities，涵盖潜行/隐形侦测与陷阱侦测，译文窄化为「陷阱侦查强度受灵巧加成。」，漏掉潜行与隐形侦测同样随灵巧成长。证据：engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/talents/cunning/survival.lua 的 Heightened Senses（第 21 行），seePower（第 28 行）=combatScale(self:getCun(15,true)*getTalentLevel(t),…) 与 trapDetect（第 29 行）=combatScale(getTalentLevel(t)*self:getCun(25,true),…) 均以 getCun 为自变量，passives 第 36-39 行分别写入 see_invisible/see_stealth 与 see_traps，info 第 47 行按 t.sense、t.seePower、t.trapDetect 顺序填充三个 %d。
source:
You notice the small things others do not notice, allowing you to "see" creatures in a %d radius even outside of light radius.
		This is not telepathy, however, and it is still limited to line of sight.
		Also, your attention to detail increases stealth detection and invisibility detection by %d, and you gain the ability to detect traps (+%d detect 'power').
		The detection abilities improve with Cunning.
surface_observation: 原文末句 The detection abilities improve with Cunning 泛指前述侦测能力，译文缩为“陷阱侦查强度受灵巧加成”，遗漏其他侦测能力的加成描述。
target:
你注意到他人注意不到的细节，甚至能在阴影区域“看到”怪物，%d 码半径范围。
		注意此能力不属于心灵感应，仍然受到视野的限制。
		同时你的细致观察使你侦察潜行和隐身的能力增加 %d，使你发现周围的陷阱的能力增加 %d。
		陷阱侦查强度受灵巧加成。

source: A disgusting and mismatched construct of necromantically-enhanced troll bits and shattered weapons. Confused and furious, it rends and shatters its surroundings with impossible strength, moving with speed found nowhere in nature.
target: 一个由死灵法术强化的巨魔残肢与碎裂武器拼凑而成的恶心造物。它困惑而暴怒，以不可思议的力量撕裂摧毁周围的一切，移动速度在自然界中无处可寻。

source: Sadly I am the bringer of bad news, the orcs are planning something. Good luck, my lady.
target: 恐怕我带来了一些坏消息，兽人正筹划着什么阴谋，祝你好运，女士。

source: Spin around, extending your weapon and damaging all targets around you for %d%% weapon damage.
target: 原地旋转，伸展你的武器，伤害你周围所有的目标，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。

source: Drawing strength from the death of all they encounter, the Cursed become terrifying combatants.
target: 他们从他们遇到的死亡中吸取力量，成为恐怖的战士。

source: Rings make your fingers look great!
target: 戒指让你的手指更加美丽！

source: Before you stands a tall figure -- a very tall figure, propped high by a thick serpent's tail in place of where his legs should rightly be. His torso is human-like, with bulging muscles beneath fitted armour, and large hands gripping a fiercely sharp trident. He glares at you with dark intensity, like a wolf about to pounce on unsuspecting prey.
target: 在你面前站着一个高大的人影——一个非常高的人形怪物，在腿部长着巨大的蛇尾巴，他以此来支撑他的身体。他的上半身是人形，护甲下面隐约可见发达的肌肉，两只巨大的双手紧握着锋利的三叉戟。他带着阴沉的锐利目光盯着你，像一头随时准备扑向毫无防备猎物的狼。

surface_observation: 原文“Give Sher'tul fortress energy”表示给夏·图尔堡垒提供能量，译文“获得夏·图尔堡垒能量”将给予译成了获取，动作方向不一致。

source: You are not able to Disengage in that direction.
target: 你不能朝这个方向后跳。

source: Exterminate every foe on the level.
target: 杀死这一层的所有敌人。

source:
Toss out a grappling hook to a target within range %d.  If this strikes either a wall or a creature that is immovable or larger than you, you will pull yourself towards it, otherwise, you will drag the target towards you.  Creatures struck by the hook will be pinned for 2 turns.
		Your grapple target must be at least 2 tiles from you.
#YELLOW#Prepared with: %s#LAST#
target:
朝 %d 格范围内的目标发射钩爪，如果目标是墙壁、目标不能移动或目标体型比你大，你将被拉过去，否则将目标拉过来。之后，目标将被定身 2 回合。
		钩爪至少要发射到两格外。
#YELLOW#装备于：%s#LAST#

source:
I have seen the Queen in glory true
And she has moved me to my soul
Oh Queen! Let me be a part of you!
Please devour me! Swallow me whole!!
target:
我见到了女王真正的荣光
她令我的灵魂为之震颤
啊，女王！让我成为你的一部分吧！
请吞噬我！把我整个吞下吧！！

source: My masterpiece walks! It is glorious, beautiful. While it remains unfinished, it is finished enough to serve in its purpose of protecting my lair. No would-be hero will be able to defeat it, and once it is complete it will be nigh invulnerable! Now all that remains is to animate my newest minion and bend it to my will... then they'll see. They'll ALL see. What can possibly stop me now, I ask? What?!
target: 我的杰作走起来了！它壮丽而美妙。虽然尚未彻底完成，却已经足以履行守卫我巢穴的使命。没有哪个自诩英雄的人能够击败它；等到它完全完成，更将近乎无敌！现在只剩唤醒我最新的仆从、使其屈从于我的意志……到时他们就会明白。他们全都会明白。我倒要问，如今还有什么能阻止我？什么？！

source: A Human hailing from the northern town of Derth. A common kind of man, unremarkable in all respects.
target: 一位来自北方小镇德斯的人类。一种随处可见的普通人，各方面都毫无特点。

source: This thick robe is woven from a dark green moss, firmly bound and cool to the touch. It is said to have rejuvenating properties.
target: 这件厚厚的长袍使用一大块深绿的苔藓织成的，十分牢固，摸上去很清凉。据说，它能让人恢复青春。

source: You swap locations with a random target.
target: 你和一个随机目标交换位置。
治疗师亚斯特莉的日志

source:
During your adventures you will find items.
Each item has a weight. How much you can carry depends on your Strength: this is your maximum encumbrance.
To pickup an item, press 'g' or right click on yourself and choose 'Pickup item' while standing over it.
To view your inventory, press 'i' or right-click on yourself and choose 'Inventory'.

Your inventory is split in two panels: your equipped items and your backpack.
To select an item, use the movement keys and press enter, click it with the mouse, or press the key next to its name.

The item you've found is an infusion. Infusions and runes allow you to bind a power to your body, gaining new abilities.
Infusions come from the powers of nature while runes use magic and have unlimited uses once inscribed.
This infusion inscribes you with the power to regenerate your life at will. You can only have a finite number of inscriptions, but they can easily be replaced.

Now move on to the west.
target:
在你的冒险过程中你会获得各种各样的物品。
每一件物品都有重量。你能携带多少物品取决于你的力量属性：你有一个最大负重上限。
按下 'g'键来拾取物品，或者当你的人物站在物品上时右键点击你自己并选择拾取物品。
要查看物品栏，按下 'i'键或者右键点击自己选择物品栏。

你的物品栏被分成两个部分：你装备的物品和背包中的物品。
选择物品，可以用移动键来选择再按Enter来确认，或者直接鼠标左键单击即可，也可以
直接按物品名字旁边的快捷键。

你发现的物品是一个纹身，纹身和符文可以将一种能力印刻到你的身上，获得新的技能。
纹身源于自然之力；符文则使用魔法，刻印后可以无限次使用。
这个纹身的功能是能使你在你需要的时候回复生命值。你只能印刻有限数量的刻印，但
你可以轻松地替换它们。

现在继续向西前进。

deep_observation: 「temporal shear」译作「灵刃切变」，把 temporal（时空）替换成「灵刃」，且「灵刃切变」正是同版本 zh_hans.lua:21735 给技能名 Blade Shear 的译名，等于用技能名指代其造成的效果。证据：engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/talents/chronomancy/blade-threading.lua，Blade Shear 定义在第 176 行，第 244 行的本条 logSeen 与第 234-244 行 DamageType.TEMPORAL 锥形投射同属一次 temporal shear；同技能描述（同文件第 258 行）在 zh_hans.lua:21738-21742 中把同一 temporal shear 译作「时空切变」，同一技能内同词两译。
surface_observation: 原文 temporal shear 中的 temporal 表示时间，译文“灵刃切变”将其误写成灵刃。

source: #Target# is covered in a veil of shadows!

target: 通用 近战酸性腐蚀伤害

source: #CRIMSON#[The area around you erupts in flames, burning your foes]
target: #CRIMSON#[你周围的区域爆发烈焰，焚烧你的敌人]

deep_observation: (1) 机制遗漏：「While you are split both of you gain %d%% all resistances.」中的 both of you（本体与分裂体双方）在「当你分裂时，你增加 %d%% 所有抵抗。」中丢失，读作只有本体获益。证据：engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/talents/gifts/malleable-body.lua:40；同段第 39 行 Your two selves share the same healthpool 在本译文中已译出「你和分裂体共享生命」，可见双方口径本可保留。(2) all resistances 指全伤害类型抗性（同文件第 42 行 tformat 传入 10 + self:combatTalentMindDamage(t,5,200)/10），译作「所有抵抗」，与本批次第 2 条（water.lua Shivgoroth Form）把 cold resistance 译作「寒冷伤害抗性」、把 cuts/stuns 的 resistance 译作「抵抗」的区分相撞，构成跨条术语不一致。
source:
Your body is more like that of an ooze, you can split into two for %d turns.
		Your original self has the original ooze aspect while your mitosis gains the acid aspect.
		If you know the Oozing Blades tree all the talents inside are exchanged for those of the Corrosive Blades tree.
		Your two selves share the same healthpool.
		While you are split both of you gain %d%% all resistances.
		Resistances will increase with Mindpower.
surface_observation: 原文明确说明分裂后两个自身均获得 %d%% 全抗性；译文只说“你增加”，遗漏分裂体也获得抗性的说明。
target:
你的身体变的像软泥怪一样，你可以分裂成2个，持续 %d 回合。
		你的本体获得原始的软泥特性，而分裂体则获得酸性特性。
		如果你习得软泥之刃系技能树，则该技能树会变为腐蚀之刃技能树。
		你和分裂体共享生命。
		当你分裂时，你增加 %d%% 所有抵抗。
		抵抗受精神强度加成。

source: All that glitters is not gold; all that is gold does not glitter.
target: 发光的不都是金子，金子不都是发光的。

source: Lead on; I will protect you.
Adventurers can learn to do a bit of everything, getting training in whatever they happen to find.
target: 冒险家可以学习很多技能，他们可以学习任何碰巧发现的技能。

deep_observation: 「all foes」译作「所有生物」，把敌对范围扩大为全部生物。证据：engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63 game/modules/tome/data/birth/descriptors.lua 的 Madness desc 列表中本条在第 282 行，同列表第 276 行为 All creature talent levels increased by 170%、第 278 行为 All enemies have 200% more life；同版本 game/modules/tome/data/locales/zh_hans.lua:3269 已把 creature 那条译为「所有生物技能等级增加 170%」、3271 把 enemies 那条译为「所有敌人血量增加 200%」，即同一列表内「生物」对应 creature、「敌人」对应 enemies/foes，本条用「所有生物」与之相撞。
source: Player is being hunted! Randomly all foes in a radius will get a feeling of where she/he is
surface_observation: 原文 all foes 指所有敌人，译文“所有生物”扩大了感知玩家位置的对象范围。
target: 玩家处于被捕猎的状态，随机地，一定半径内的所有生物都会感知到你所在的位置。

source: %s slams %s %s into the ground, sending out a shockwave!
A strange luminescent growth on the dungeon floor.
target: 地板上的奇特闪光植物。

source: This tall elf rushes at you, wielding both her greatsword and magical spells.
target: 这位高大的精灵冲向你，同时带来她锋利的大剑和魔法的怒吼。

source: Won the game without ever taking off his mankini.
target: 在没有脱下男士比基尼的情况下获得胜利。

source: @Source@'s evil twin has come from another timeline.
target: @Source@的邪恶双胞胎从另一个时间线赶来。

source: A slender metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth.
target: 瘦长的金属怪物，手指的位置长着长长的爪子，还有剃刀般锋利的牙齿。

source:
I have definitely seen crystals move of their own volition here, and some even seem capable of producing magical effects in self-defence. They are no threat to me whatsoever - my arcane powers are far beyond whatever latent magic seems to possess these things.

Possession... is what it almost seems like. These crystals are not natural. I have broken some down and studied them, and the very structure of the material seems vastly distinct from any other I have seen. I have even studied Sher'Tul relics in the Academy and this is most certainly something different. Truly fascinating!
target:
我确实亲眼看到这里的水晶自行移动，有些甚至能产生魔法效应自卫。不过它们根本威胁不到我——我的奥术力量远远胜过那股似乎占据着它们的潜藏魔力。

占据……看上去几乎就是这么回事。这些水晶并非天然产物。我敲碎了一些加以研究，发现这种材质本身的结构，与我见过的任何材质都截然不同。我甚至在学院研究过夏·图尔遗物，而这绝对是截然不同的东西。实在迷人！

source: Increases attack speed by %d%%, grants infinite ammo, and causes all marking shots to have a 100%% increased chance to mark.
target: 攻击速度增加 %d%%，弹药无限，所有标记射击的标记几率提高100%%。

source: #LIGHT_RED#You are brought back from the Fearscape!
